description: Initial screenshot and image registry for future Soleat User Manual and TMA contextual help integration. No image assets are included yet.

items.title: Soleat Menu launcher overview
items.purpose: Show users the main visual entry point for Soleat features.
items.altTextDraft: Soleat Menu showing the main feature launcher inside Telegram.

items.title: Cuisine Search overview
items.purpose: Show cuisine selection, filters, map/list layout, and search controls.
items.altTextDraft: Cuisine Search screen with cuisine choices, filters, and result controls.

items.title: Eatery Card annotated
items.purpose: Explain the parts of an eatery card: place name, label, opening info, recognition, what-to-try, map, transport, and copy actions.
items.altTextDraft: Annotated eatery card showing food-place details and available actions.

items.title: Google Map View layers
items.purpose: Show how map layers help users add or remove nearby practical context.
items.altTextDraft: Google Map View with optional layers for nearby context.

items.title: Recognised Venue badges
items.purpose: Show how recognised or curated signals appear without implying a guarantee.
items.altTextDraft: Recognised venue result showing curated-source or recognition badge context.

items.title: Singapore Hawker Centres map and list
items.purpose: Show hawker-centre discovery with map and list context.
items.altTextDraft: Singapore Hawker Centres view showing hawker-centre map and list context.

items.title: Singapore Train Station Exits
items.purpose: Show how station exits support the walking part of food planning.
items.altTextDraft: Singapore train station context with station exits for nearby walking routes.

items.title: Singapore Bus Information near station
items.purpose: Show nearby bus stops and live-arrival context where available.
items.altTextDraft: Singapore Bus Information showing nearby bus stops and arrival context.

items.title: Singapore Car Parks live-lot context
items.purpose: Show car park decision-support information for users who are driving.
items.altTextDraft: Singapore Car Parks view showing nearby car park context and available-lot information where available.

items.title: Weather decision-support view
items.purpose: Show weather context used for walking, route, and food-place decisions.
items.altTextDraft: Weather view showing current or short-term forecast context.

items.title: Sketchbook structure
items.purpose: Explain Catch-all, Cabinet, Drawer, and Card using the physical filing metaphor.
items.altTextDraft: Sketchbook structure diagram showing Catch-all, Cabinet, Drawer, and Card.

items.title: No results recovery
items.purpose: Show how users can broaden a search or reduce filters when results are weak or empty.
items.altTextDraft: Troubleshooting view showing how to recover from no results or weak results.
